ge_kappa.description: Generalized-endpoint step-1 additive q/pT bias in DATA relative to MC (q/pT_meas = q/pT_true + kappa), TuneP pT; corrected on data above the threshold as q/pT -> q/pT - kappa. Step 2 not applied (as EXO-25-021).
ge_kappa.source: [talk] slide 11, '1. Single muon (phi modulation): results', panel 2025; identical to [AN] Fig. 24 (PDF p. 38, printed p. 36), bottom right. The [POG] page (High pT: Momentum Scale) links this slide for the 2024 and 2025 values. MUO approval: [AN] l. 592-594, [talk] slide 17 (validated on the full 2022-2025 dataset).
ge_kappa.layout: kappa[i][j]: i = eta bin (ascending, signed eta), j = phi bin (ascending from -pi). On [talk] slide 11 eta runs along x and phi along y (+pi at the top).

mc_smearing.description: MC p -> p * (1 + N(0, sigma(p, |eta|) * f)), f = sqrt((1 + x)^2 - 1), above the threshold. Nominal x = extra_smear; MuSmear up/down use x = extra_smear +- syst (POG: 10 %).
mc_smearing.sigma_source: [AN] Fig. 18 (PDF p. 33) and l. 553-555: the EXO-25-021 derivation on the 2024 MC, which 2025 uses too ('As for 2025 data, we use MC from the 2024 campaign, the same momentum parametrisation is utilised'). The [POG] page lists the 2025 high-pT resolution as work in progress.
mc_smearing.extra_smear_source: [AN] l. 573-577 and Fig. 21 (PDF p. 36): the 2024 value, 15 %, is insufficient for the 2025 data; 25 % describes the Z-peak widths. [talk] slide 7 (2026-03-22) had proposed treating 2025 as 2024; the later [AN] v11 (2026-09-03) is followed.
mc_smearing.syst_source: [POG] High pT: Momentum Resolution: a 10 % shift for barrel and endcap muons.
mc_smearing.sigma_note: Coefficients from the fit boxes of [AN] Fig. 18 (PDF p. 33). The [AN] formula at l. 553 prints the endcap constant as 0.000689, a factor 10 below its fit box (p0 = 0.00688956); the fit box is used.
mc_smearing.sigma_p_max_note: [AN] Fig. 18 fits p_gen up to 2.5 TeV; above that sigma is held at its 2.5 TeV value (our choice, no cubic extrapolation).
